issues: indel_pct=88.0 is synthetic demo data, not a measurement (DEMO_REPORT.md)
demo n=4, Spearman rho=0.800 p=0.2 — not statistically significant
specificity=1.0 is the empty-off-target-list fallback, not evidence of specificity
0.3 of the weight budget is a constant and adds zero ranking information
weights w_seq/w_atac/w_spec = 0.4/0.3/0.3 are untuned and unvalidated
on real data (n=199) combined score rho=0.315 UNDERPERFORMS sequence-only rho=0.441
demo seq_efficacy=0.661 conflicts with 0.467 for GZMA in the real-ATAC cross-context run
Xu et al. 2018 (core corpus, same RNP delivery) reports <30% cross-cell-type variance for the same gRNA
accessibility term validated only for transient RNP; no delivery-method input exists in the code
ATAC term saturates at 0.1, discarding all dynamic range in open chromatin
cross-context 11/11 panel check is near-circular and has no indel ground truth
T-cell activation state not modeled (Ursch 2024); 'T' is not a single chromatin context
indel% is not functional knockout — no frameshift/repair-outcome term
rationale: This is the single most favorable row in the set — high ATAC, passes the Ito AND-gate, and its direction is independently corroborated by the real-ATAC cross-context panel — yet its outcome value (88% indel) is fabricated demo data, so it validates nothing. Confidence is capped low because the one component that actually correlates with real indel% (sequence) is diluted by an untuned accessibility weight and a specificity term that is a constant 1.0 placeholder.

issues: indel_pct=9.0 is synthetic demo data, not a measurement
9% indel sits near the Sanger+ICE detection floor — least reliable end of the readout
demo accessibility=0.20 (atac~0.02) contradicts accessibility=0.0 for GZMA/K562 in the real-ATAC run
specificity=1.0 is the empty-off-target-list fallback, not evidence of specificity
K562 is near-triploid with a rearranged CML genome — copy number confounds indel%
guides designed on reference genome; K562 sequence variants not checked (Kumbara 2025: 82.5% of guides affected)
ATAC threshold 0.1 transferred across GEO series (GSE221788 vs GSE137647) without cross-dataset normalization
Xu et al. 2018 attributes cross-cell-type efficiency gaps to delivery artifact, not chromatin
no delivery-method gate despite Wang 2019 showing accessibility does not help in lentiviral context
low-signal rows drive the apparent context effect that the real n=199 benchmark fails to reproduce (ATAC-only rho=0.084, p=0.24)
rationale: This row exists to make the context effect look dramatic (88% -> 9%), but the number is synthetic, sits at the assay's noise floor, and its accessibility value disagrees with the value the real-ATAC run computed for the same gene and cell type. On genuine Ito data the accessibility component is statistically indistinguishable from noise, so the mechanism this row illustrates is the one the benchmark most clearly failed to confirm.

issues: indel_pct=81.0 is synthetic demo data, not a measurement
GATA1 is a lineage-essential dependency in K562 — edited cells drop out, confounding indel% by selection
no timepoint or selection/dropout model in the score
GATA1 is X-linked and K562 is near-triploid — allele count unmodeled
demo seq_efficacy=0.61 conflicts with 0.80 for GATA1 in the real-ATAC cross-context run
specificity=1.0 is the empty-off-target-list fallback, not evidence of specificity
weights untuned; combined score underperforms sequence-only on real data
cross-context panel used the weak GC/motif fallback where DeepSpCas9/CHOPCHOP scores were available elsewhere
off-target risk is itself cell-context dependent (Sari 2025) but specificity() takes no cell_type argument
Wang 2019 on-target/off-target trade-off violates the additive independence the linear formula assumes
rationale: Beyond the synthetic outcome value, GATA1 in K562 carries a specific unmodeled confounder: it is an essential erythroid transcription factor in that line, so measured indel% reflects survival selection against edited cells as much as cutting efficiency. The score has no essentiality, timepoint, or ploidy term, and its own components disagree between the demo and the real-ATAC run for this exact gene.

no independent corroboration from any real-data run

rationale: This is the weakest row in the set: a fabricated low indel value at the assay noise floor, an accessibility number that disagrees by more than 50% with what the real-ATAC pipeline computed for the same gene and context, and no corroborating real-data evidence of any kind. Nothing here should be treated as validation of cell-context-aware scoring.
